user_questions.question: Scope check (2 questions). (1) Which status should stamp Refund__c.Processed_Date__c? Evidence: all three creators (IssueRefundReceiptAction, Issue_Refund, Apply_Remediation) already insert refunds as Status__c = 'Approved' with Issue_Date__c = today, and the field description says 'The date the refund was processed/completed'. Options: (a) Approved, as written (the stamp would equal Issue_Date__c on every new refund); (b) Completed, matching the field description; (c) keep Processed_Date__c for Completed and add a new Approved_Date__c for approval. (2) If Processed_Date__c already has a value, should it be overwritten or only set when blank?
user_questions.simulated_answer: (b) Completed - when the money has gone out, not Approved. Only set it if it is blank.

skill_friction: Combined R+T call (500 words) timed out at 60s even with a 1-item inventory; the template allows combining for <=8 changes, but the combined call was too large. Splitting R and T into two 250-word calls worked. Unclear whether the split counts as one retry (SKILL says 'A split counts as one retry') - recorded as two retry-kind calls.
run.json 'kind' enum has no way to mark a split retry that is effectively R and T separately; used 'retry' for both halves.

Module rule 'Do not invent paths' vs. new metadata type with no existing folder (force-app/main/default/flows does not exist): unclear whether the standard source-format path counts as known or should be 'Not specified'. Used the standard path and listed it as an assumption.
